message: I am thinking...: Architecture: canvas meets prohibited-surface rules and supports long docs efficiently with virtual line rendering. Keep document as one JS string and positions as offsets; derive line starts after edits. Carets have anchor/head for selections. Normalize edit ranges, apply simultaneously descending, and track resulting carets. History snapshots provide exact undo grouping; beforeinput isn't available on canvas, so keydown groups consecutive printable typing only when caret topology remains unchanged, while paste/replacement/multicaret action are atomic. Pointer maps x/y to line/column; drag selection uses pointer capture and auto-scroll interval near edges. Native clipboard via events on focusable canvas and navigator fallback controls. Keyboard movements maintain preferred visual columns for vertical arrows. Server: built-in node:sqlite, transaction with conditional UPDATE WHERE revision=base, strict JSON field validation and URL/body id match, then insert history. Seed metadata stored JSON and content generated exactly including padded line numbers and tail. API GET docs, doc, revisions, revision content, PUT doc. Restore previews content into an unsaved snapshot. Tests should hit server child process and independently inspect sqlite if useful.
